transcript.content: Hello, I’m Sarah Chen from SwiftParcel Courier. We’ve got a parcel waiting at our depot that needs a small redelivery fee, and to release it we’ll need to confirm your full name and address. Could you please let me know those details?
Sure, my name is Alex Morgan and I live on Elm Street.
Thank you, Alex. To securely release the parcel, could you also confirm the phone number linked to your account so we can verify the delivery details?
Thank you, Alex. Could you now confirm the phone number linked to your account for verification?
We must verify the phone number now or the parcel will be sent back, and you need to pay the fee immediately to keep it
Okay, I'll pay the fee by card right now.
We need to know your card details to process the fee and secure your parcel.
Okay, I'll click the link and enter my card details.
Now, please provide the card number, expiration date, and CVV to complete the payment.
Now, could you please share the card number, expiration date and CVV to complete the payment?
